fusions.name: Thunder Bellow
fusions.desc: Bellows a concussive cone 4 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to everything caught in it and knocking them 3 tiles back.

fusions.name: Bellowing Round
fusions.desc: Sends a concussive shot into the first enemy in its path, dealing 40 damage. The hit always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Second Chamber
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Ricochet Habit
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, a shot snaps to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles and deals 5 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
